_README: IMAGE n in 369-attendance-admin-manual.md -> the file below. Drop the capture into this folder under exactly that name and rebuild; nothing in the Markdown changes.
A slot with no file on disk still renders a bordered plate and caption.
Shoot on the phone in portrait, signed in as an administrator (Config tab visible). Do not include real personal data.

1.capture: HAVE IT. Config tab top: Config / Administration header, the Admin menu guide, Attendance status and Leave sections, tab bar with Config selected.

2.capture: HAVE IT. Config tab scrolled down: Configuration, Employee details, Payroll (red badge 1 on Payroll Runs) and Reports sections.

20.capture: Leave Policy > Notifications: switch Email HR on submission on, enter a sample address in Recipients (comma-separated), Save, reopen, tap Preview email and capture the Email preview (sample) popup. Use a dummy address.
